CONTRATTO DI LOCAZIONE ABILITIVA A CANONE CONCORDATO (L. 431/1998)
REGISTRATO PRESSO LAGENZIA DELLE ENTRATE DI GENOVA 1 - SERIE 3T N. 084910
Con la presente somma per una relativa opura tra d. Sig. ENRKO CASAGRANDE, C.F. CSGNRC9H14D969L, residente a Genova in Via Montallegro 15 (Locatore), e la Sigra GIULIA VASSALLO, C.F. VSSLGL92A1D868, residenta a Genova Ciao Magenta 8 (Conduttore).
SI CONVIENE ESTINZA QUANTO SIGNIE
ART. 1 (DURATA): La locazione la durata di un treno desordenata dal 01/11/2024 al 31/10/2027. Alla prima scadenza il contratto sera prorogato di due anni (formula 3+2) alle medesime condizione.
ART. 2 (CANONE): L'ocasione nello concordato nella somma di Euro 7,800,00 (settentiaottocento/00), pari ad Euro 650,00 mensal, determinato in base all'accordo termenale del Comune di Genova del 24/07/2023 per la Zona B1, con attenzione di riproduzione per UPR-GE-8491.
ART. 3 (DEPOSITO CAUZENALE): A gara di tutte le obbligazioni contrattuali, d'Conduttore versa la somma di Euro 1,950,00 pari a tre mensili di canone a mezzo bonifico bancario, fruttiera di interessi legali annu.
ART. 4 (ALGINE ESCALI CIDO ASESECA). Il Locatore dichasta di avvaleri dell'opzione per l'applicazione della codolare secca agevolata con alquota al 10% ai sensa dell'art. 3 del D I gx. 23/2011, runitando espressamente per tutta la durata alla fico in a reborno agregato INTAT del canone.
ART. 5 (SPISI CUNDOMIDALE): Le permissione di amministrazione e riscaldamento centralizzato sono quantificate in accosto mensile di Furo 95,00 salvo cengaglio annuale su rendiconto approvato.

UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS

APOLLO DEFENSE TECHNOLOGIES CORP. - DELAWARE GENERAL CORPORATION LAW SECTION 141(f)

The undersigned, being all the members of the Board of Directors of APOLLO DEFENSE TECHNOLOGIES CORP., a Delaware corporation (the "Corporation"), hereby unanimously consent in writing to the adoption of the following resolutions pursuant to Section 141(f) of the DGCL:

SIRB'S B PREFERRED STOCK FINANCING RESOLUTIONS

WHEREAS the Board deems it to be in the best financial interests of the Corporation and its stockholders to issue and sell up to 17,500,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock at a purchase price of $ 4.80 per share, for an aggregate gross proceeds of $ 60,000,000.00, pursuant to the Series B Stock Purchase Agreement presented to the Board.

NOW THEREFORE, HEIT RESOLVED, that the Certificate of Incorporation of the Corporation, be amended and restated in its entirety (the Restated Certificate) to increase the authorized Common Stock to 120,000,000 shares and the authorized Preferred Stock to 35,000,000 shares, par value $0.0001 per share.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial Officer, and the Secretary are each authorized to execute and deliver the Series B Purchase Agreement, the Investors' Rights Agreement, the Right of First Refusal and Co-Sale Agreement, and the Voting Agreement on behalf of the Corporation.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that an aggregate of 3,500,000 shares of Common Stock be newly reserved for issuance under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan for key engineering personnel.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Written Consent as of October 28, 2024. Signatures: Thomas H. Vance, Chairman; Victoria M. Sterling, Director; Dr. Raymond Chen, Director.

SUB-TIER DEFENSE PROCUREMENT SPECIFICATION & STATEMENT OF WORK

CONTRACT NO: N00019-24-C-8491 | DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY (DLA) | CAGE: 18491

SECTION C: STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW). HIGH STRENGTH HY 80 STEEL PRESSURE HULL FABRICATION

1. SCOPE: This specification establishes the maximum metallurgical, ultrasonic, and radiographic testing requirements for structural submarine hull penetration collars installed on Virginia class submarines.

2. APPLICABLE MILITARY SPECIFICATIONS: MIL. S 16216 (Steel Plate, Alloy, Structural, High Yield Strength HY 80 and HY 100). NAVSEA Technical Publication T9074 AD GB 010/1688 (Requirements for Fabrication, Welding and Inspection of Submarine Structure), MIL. STD 2035 (Ultrasound Inspection Acceptance Criteria).

3. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROVISIONS: Contractor shall maintain an ISO 9001 / AS9100 certified quality management system. 100% of all full penetration hull welds shall undergo magnetic particle testing (MT) per ASTM E1444 and volumetric radiographical testing (RT) per ASTM E1742 Level 2.1T sensitivity.

4. TRACEABILITY & MATERIAL TEST REPORTS: Certified Material Test Reports (CMTR) documenting chemical melt analysis (C, Mn, P, S, Si, Ni, Cr, Mo, V) and Charpy V Notch impact energy (minimum 60 ft lbs at 120 deg F) shall accompany each delivery lot.
